apps.localizedDescription:
StreamCenter is your all-in-one hub for live sports streaming.

Watch NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, MMA, boxing, and more — pulled straight from the web, with no ads interrupting the action.

• Add any sports streaming site as a custom source
• Browse live and upcoming games across every league
• Favorite your teams and leagues for instant access
• Ad-free playback powered by a built-in content blocker
• Supports m3u8 and DASH streams with native AVPlayer quality
• No account required. No subscription. Completely free.

versions.localizedDescription: Unified single-tab UI. Streams and Leagues are merged into one home page; bottom tab bar removed. A horizontal row of circular chips below the title filters the stream list (All first, then one chip per league in the existing popularity order). Settings is now a gear icon in the top-right. Long-press a chip to favorite the league.

Diagnose typo'd / parked-domain sources. WebViewScraper now captures the page title (rendered in Source Diagnostics), and fetchAvailableLeagues bails fast when the title matches known parking templates (Redirecting…, Rebrandly, ParkLogic, HugeDomains, Sedo, GoDaddy, "is for sale", "Branded Short Domain"). Catches typo'd hostnames like buffstreans.plus → buffstreams.plus. Foundation Models also receives the page title as additional classification context.

Fix "no leagues detected" on NTVSTREAM-style sites (ntv.cx). Added /api/get-matches to APIDiscovery's candidate paths and a new shape parser for the {success, all/live/upcoming: [...]} response format used by NTVSTREAM and similar Vue/Nuxt SPAs. Fixed epoch-millisecond date parsing (auto-detects 13-digit timestamps) and honors explicit live booleans from API responses. Watch URLs are reconstructed as /watch/{source}/{id} matching the front-end pattern.

Diagnose ntv.sh-style "no leagues detected": (1) Parked-domain fast-fail — homepages whose links all go off-domain (Rebrandly broken-links, GoDaddy parking) now bail out immediately instead of running a multi-minute probe sweep. (2) Parallel probing — ESPN pre-warm, Foundation Models, and proactive section probing run concurrently, so a slow/hung iOS 26 LLM call no longer blocks the probes. (3) 10s timeout on Foundation Models. (4) FM results union with rule-based + proactive rather than short-circuiting.

Fix "no leagues detected" on sites whose homepage exposes no classifiable league anchors (e.g. ntv.sh). fetchAvailableLeagues now proactively probes /live/{slug}, /{slug}, /sports/{slug} for every supported league in parallel with homepage-hinted probes. Tighter section-page verification prevents mixed "live now" pages from falsely confirming leagues.

HostFallback silently retries TLD variants when a source hostname fails DNS (content-block / carrier filter / Screen Time). Looser league matching catches /league/nflstreams, /nbaregular66, /mlbwildcard style slugs. Plus prior fixes: CachedAsyncImage, persistent TeamLogoStore, word-boundary team match, UFL→Other, ESPN-aware classification, generic API discovery. No default sources — add your own.
